about: Breeder questions for eval/harness.py. Each names the KIND of answer it expects; the harness computes the answer by code from the cache copy it runs on, so this file holds no answers. The study and trait catalogs answer q01-q12; q13-q14 need the cached measurements of study 05DISE178HFLNO7 (SweetPotatoBase study 4501, variable 76736), which are in CassavaBase\part2\cache\live.
